title: BCIAUT-P300 dataset for autism from Simoes et al 2020
description: EEG recordings from 15 adolescents and adults with autism spectrum disorder who took part in a P300-based brain-computer interface joint-attention training in a virtual environment. Each participant completed 7 sessions of 2 runs, with 8 EEG channels recorded at 250 Hz while flashing objects served as target and non-target stimuli. The dataset serves as a multi-session, multi-subject benchmark for P300 BCI classification and is distributed in a BIDS-formatted version produced with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a wireless g.Nautilus system (g.tec) at 250 Hz from 8 channels (C3, Cz, C4, CPz, P3, Pz, P4, POz). The reference was the right ear and the ground was AFz. Participants viewed 8 flashing objects in a virtual environment. Each session contained 1600 training trials plus 400*K online test trials (K=3-10). Data were band-pass filtered at 2-30 Hz and epoched over 0-1.2 s.
